about.title: About Me
about.description:
I'm a Fullstack Developer with an extensive background in creating fast, scalable, and user-centered complete systems. I specialize in crafting robust backends using Node.js, Express, and NestJS, coupled with design and optimization of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and seamless integration with modern frontend ecosystems like React and Next.js.

My approach bridges the gap between clean code, system architecture, and cutting-edge intelligence: I specialize in designing and engineering custom AI Agents, LLM orchestration, and smart workflow automations that eliminate manual tasks and elevate business capabilities.

I thrive on building scalable, modular architectures, optimizing query performance, and deploying bulletproof Cloud applications. Collaborative, communicative, and technically versatile, I focus on delivering end-to-end solutions that solve complex real-world problems with maximum quality.
